fact: World Bank lead economist Leora Klapper says 73% of Namibian adults now own a financial account, citing Global Findex 2025 figures as reported by The Brief.

The Namibia Statistics Agency's 2025 Namibia Financial Inclusion Survey (fieldwork October-November 2025) finds 75.6 percent of adults aged 15 and over hold a bank account, with 18.3 percent holding a smart card account.
